dolomites-giau-falzarego-and-cortina-hig.title: Dolomites · Giau, Falzarego and Cortina High Road
dolomites-giau-falzarego-and-cortina-hig.slogan: Two passes and 54 km, high point 2250 m
dolomites-giau-falzarego-and-cortina-hig.story: Sharper, higher, wilder: a Dolomite day with status checks mandatory. A 54 km loop that starts and ends near Selva di Cadore, about 1 h 02 of riding. The climbs: Passo Giau, Falzarego Pass and Valparola high road. It tops out at about 2,250 m. It is a high-mountain day.

sections.advice: This Falzarego Pass → Valparola high road stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Valparola high road → Corvara food base is the reward section in Dolomites. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

scenicChapters.title: Passo di Giau · Dolomites
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 8 km this is Passo di Giau · Dolomites, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

dolomites-sella-ronda-overnight-scout-ar.title: Dolomites Sella Ronda Overnight Scout · short arc
dolomites-sella-ronda-overnight-scout-ar.slogan: Chur eastbound to Val Gardena overnight base · one way, about 554 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Chur eastbound gate
waypoints.advice: Chur eastbound is where the day begins. Next is Ofenpass approach, climbing 1556 m.

waypoints.name: Ofenpass approach
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2149 m here. The road climbs 1556 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 10 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Pordoi Pass.

waypoints.name: Pordoi Pass
waypoints.advice: 2239 m, and the road stops climbing. Reckon on about 11 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Campolongo Pass, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Campolongo Pass
waypoints.advice: The high point of this section, 1875 m up. You lose 364 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 8 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Gardena Pass, climbing 261 m.

waypoints.name: Gardena Pass
waypoints.advice: Gardena Pass tops the climb at 2136 m. The road climbs 261 m on the way up to it, steadily. Next is Val Gardena overnight base, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Val Gardena overnight base
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 554 km. You lose 576 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind.

sections.advice: Chur eastbound gate → Ofenpass approach climbs about 1556 m in 78 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Ofenpass approach → Pordoi Pass is 147 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Pordoi Pass → Campolongo Pass is 7 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Campolongo Pass → Gardena Pass is 8 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Gardena Pass → Val Gardena overnight base drops about 576 m over 8 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Height already gained and held. The road stays near 2239 m for 328 km instead of surrendering it to the next valley — exposed ground: wind matters more here than gradient. Nothing blocks it.

scenicChapters.title: Great Dolomites Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2136 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

dolomites-sella-ronda-overnight-scout-ar.story: 554 km from Chur to Santa Cristina Valgardena, about 8 h 55 of riding. The climbs: Ofenpass approach, Pordoi Pass, Campolongo Pass and Gardena Pass. It tops out at 2,239 m. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It is a high-mountain day.
